content_fields.title: Test secure build worker management (GitHub)
content_fields.description: Verify that build workers are isolated, ephemeral and least-privileged.
content_fields.guidance: Verification means confirming workers are destroyed after each job, do not share state, hold no standing production credentials, and are provisioned from a controlled image.
content_fields.found: No build worker fleet is associated with this repository.
content_fields.missing: The worker fleet and its configuration.
content_fields.conclusion: The verification targets infrastructure that does not exist for this project.
content_fields.action: The CI/CD platform team should verify the worker baseline once build automation exists.
